notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at the Zuhri: «ابن شهاب» (branch 1) and «الزهري» (branch 2) are kept as the text writes them, not merged (rule 9)
«قال سمعت عروة ... وعبيد الله بن عبد الله، عن حديث، عائشة»: the four co-transmitters form one level; «حديث» is the topic, so Aisha is the last link
«زوج النبي» and the Prophet's words are not links
